title: 🧬 Job → NCCL / NVLink Correlation (L2)
description: Given a Slurm $JobID: correlates all 9 SU1-instrumentation signals (NCCL Inspector, config/topo, nvlmapper down-lanes, host NVLink, nsys CE/SM, DCGM PROF, HCA/SHARP, step-time) on ONE screen. SU1 signals are node-labelled → joined to the job on(node); every new-signal row leads with a freshness guard (blank != healthy).

list.name: job_nodes
list.label: Job nodes (derived)
list.description: Job's node set — drives every node-scoped freshness guard and the on(node) join.

list.name: job_switches
list.label: Job leaf switches (derived)
list.description: node -> leaf switch (node_ib_link). The first hop of the node->rack mapping.

list.name: job_racks
list.label: Job NVL72 racks (derived)
list.description: node -> NVL72 rack, in the nvlmapper (nvl_lane_down) rack namespace. Requires the nvl_node_rack{node,rack} bridge (node_ib_link exposes only switch, NOT rack, so the IB-switch string must NOT be reused as the rack namespace). If the bridge is absent this resolves to All (.*) — the pre-flight gate then scopes to ALL racks (never false-GREEN; may false-RED) and the S5 nvlmapper heartbeat guard shows coverage. Override to a textbox regex if your rack namespace differs.
